name: Stunky
description: The poison that gushes from its aft end is accompanied by an utterly evil-smelling odor with such potency that one whiff can induce memory loss.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: Acid Spray
moves.description: The user spits fluid that works to melt the target. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.

moves.name: Poison Gas
moves.description: The user sprays a cloud of toxic gas that poisons the target.

moves.name: Venoshock
moves.description: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid to inflict damage. This move’s power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

moves.name: Night Slash
moves.description: The user slashes the target the instant the target lowers its guard. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.description: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless, life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user.
